summary: Verification of the PublicProfilePreviewStep topMovies.map render-crash fix. STATIC CODE REVIEW: all 3 defense-in-depth layers are correctly in place. (1) PublicProfilePreviewStep.tsx:65 uses `Array.isArray(data.topMovies) ? data.topMovies : []` AND chains `.filter((m) => m && typeof m === 'object')` to drop primitives before mapping to the {title, tmdb_id, poster_path} shape (lines 64-72). (2) PremiumProfileView.tsx:687 and :703 both gate with `Array.isArray(profile.topMovies)` / `Array.isArray(profile.filmLanguages)` before .map/length. (3) onboarding.tsx mergeTinaData (lines 159-191) declares ARRAY_FIELDS = {topMovies, genres, filmLanguages, languagesSpoken, relationshipIntent, partnerPreference, uploadedPictures, pictures} and rejects any non-array value for those fields with a console.warn, so bad LLM output never enters profile state. BACKEND smoke: 4/4 pytest cases pass (voice/status, tina/chat, user/profile/<id> 404 path, /api/matches route alive). FRONTEND runtime: app boots cleanly at https://match-history-dev.preview.emergentagent.com — login screen renders, ZERO console errors, ZERO pageerrors, ZERO 'topMovies.map is not a function' strings. The bug-trigger path requires reaching step 13 (PUBLIC_PREVIEW) through full Tina onboarding with a non-array topMovies LLM response — not reachable in a smoke run, but the static fix is provably correct and matches the user's reported crash signature. Continue/Edit testIDs ('public-preview-edit', 'public-preview-continue', 'onboarding-back-btn', 'onboarding-continue-btn') are all present.
action_items: (Optional polish) PublicProfilePreviewStep.tsx:67 uses an inline `(m: any)` cast inside .map after the typeof === 'object' filter. This is fine but a more explicit type guard `(m): m is Record<string, unknown>` would let TS prove the access of m.title/m.id/m.poster_path is safe without `any`.

(Optional defense, not blocking) Same Array.isArray guard pattern should ideally be replicated in any other consumer of profile.topMovies / profile.filmLanguages outside PremiumProfileView and PublicProfilePreviewStep (e.g. legacy match cards, swipe deck, chat preview thumbnails) — main agent may want to grep for `.topMovies.map(` / `.filmLanguages.map(` to confirm no other unguarded call sites remain.

(Verification gap) Full end-to-end repro of the original crash (Tina returns topMovies as a string like 'Inception, Interstellar') is not reachable from a smoke run because Tina's normal LLM flow currently returns arrays. To proactively cover regressions, consider a Jest/unit test on mergeTinaData with malformed payloads — but this is OPTIONAL since the runtime guards make the UI safe regardless.
critical_code_review_comments: Defense-in-depth correctly layered: (a) intake (mergeTinaData), (b) display container (PublicProfilePreviewStep), (c) reusable view (PremiumProfileView). Any one of the three layers alone would prevent the crash; together they make it impossible for a non-array topMovies to reach .map.

PublicProfilePreviewStep filter `m && typeof m === 'object'` correctly excludes both null/undefined and primitive strings/numbers — so a payload like ['Inception','Interstellar'] (array-of-strings) will not crash either; it just renders zero movies. This matches the user's intent.
mergeTinaData logs `[Onboarding] Ignoring non-array <field> from Tina` which gives the main agent a breadcrumb in production logs if Tina ever drifts.

PremiumProfileView still has 1085 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline (code review checklist). Functional, but would benefit from extracting PhotoCarousel, MessageDialog, and the sections renderer into separate files. Not blocking this iteration.

rca_of_issue: Original RCA (per main agent): Tina LLM occasionally returned topMovies as a non-array (e.g. string 'Inception, Interstellar'). The old guard `(data.topMovies || []).map(...)` failed because a non-empty string is truthy, so `|| []` did not substitute the fallback, and String.prototype.map does not exist => render crash at PublicProfilePreviewStep.tsx:65. Fix applied (verified in this iteration): defense-in-depth — (1) UI uses Array.isArray guard + object-shape filter before .map, (2) PremiumProfileView gates topMovies/filmLanguages with Array.isArray, (3) mergeTinaData ARRAY_FIELDS Set rejects non-array values for known array fields at the data intake boundary. Repro in this iteration: not reproducible (no console.error, no pageerror, app boots clean). Mitigation: complete and correctly applied.
